cards.existing: Habitual past uses imperfective: `я часто ходил в кино` (ya chasto khodil v) (I often went to the movies). Frequency words `часто`, `всегда`, `каждый день` signal imperfective.

cards.existing: `Почему` (why-cause) vs `зачем` (why-purpose). `Почему ты плачешь?` (why are you crying – what caused this?) vs `зачем ты пришёл?` (why did you come – what for?).

cards.existing: Compare: `Я читал книгу` (Ya chital knigu) (I was reading / used to read) vs `я прочитал книгу` (I read and finished it). Same English 'read', two Russian forms.

cards.existing: Word order is flexible: `Сегодня я работаю` (Segodnya ya rabotayu) and `Я сегодня работаю` both mean 'today I work'. Fronting emphasizes 'when'.

cards.existing: All animate plurals (any gender) take accusative = genitive: `вижу студентов`, `вижу женщин`. Inanimates plural use nominative shape.

cards.existing: To say "about X" use `о` / `об` + noun in -е: `думаю о доме` (dumayu o dome = thinking about home). `Об` before vowel-initial words: `об отце` (ob ottse = about dad).
